desc: Read T and loop through test cases.
For each test case, read N and array A.
Initialize an empty stack to store group values.
Iterate through each element x in A:
If stack is not empty and stack.top() == x:
Do nothing (conceptually merge x into the current group; no new operation needed to "save" it relative to the count of groups).
The answer is the size of the stack.
Print the answer for each test case.
Wrap in `if __name__ == "__main__":` and ensure fast I/O.
